title: Independent review of one finished code package

verdict.description: approved: no important finding is open (nit and pre-existing findings do not block); changes_requested: at least one important finding; blocked: the package cannot be judged from what the request holds

summary.description: Two to four sentences: what was compared with what, and the outcome

findings.description: Empty when nothing was found. Style remarks only when they hide a behavioural risk

id.description: F1, F2 ... stable across follow-up rounds

severity.description: important: a real defect the change brings in, it blocks approval; nit: worth fixing, does not block; pre-existing: it was there before the change, does not block

consequence.description: What goes wrong at runtime or for a consumer

fix.description: The smallest change that closes it

notVerified.description: What could not be judged from the request: name the missing file and what it would settle

gaps.description: Evidence gaps that prevent a verdict when blocked without findings. Use an empty list when there are none.

what.description: What the available evidence does not establish. Keep this wording for the same gap in a follow-up.

why.description: Why the evidence is insufficient and what would settle it

writerCloseable.description: Whether the writer can supply a test or other evidence within the package's scope
